muscleBalanceExplanation: Muscle balance analysis shows volume distribution and scientifically validated ratios to prevent injury and optimize performance.
insightProgressiveOverloadRegressionRec: Verify recovery status and training stress. Reference: Kraemer & Ratamess (2004)
insightProgressiveOverloadExcessiveRec: HIGH risk of overtraining/injury. Consider reducing volume. Reference: ACSM (2009)
insightProgressiveOverloadOptimalRec: Perfect sustainable progression rate! Reference: Kraemer & Ratamess (2004)
insightVolumeLowRec: Consider adding sets for optimal hypertrophy. Reference: Schoenfeld et al. (2017)
insightVolumeExcessiveRec: Risk of overtraining. Consider deload week. Reference: Schoenfeld et al. (2017)
insightIntensityLowRec: Better for muscular endurance. Increase weight for hypertrophy/strength. Reference: Reynolds et al. (2006)
insightQuadHamHighRiskRec: Hamstrings severely under-trained ({riskMultiplier} injury risk). Add RDLs, leg curls immediately. Reference: Croisier et al. (2008)
